items.name: Front brake pads
items.why: Your front pads are worn to 2 mm, so braking is weaker and they can start damaging the rotors.

items.name: Front rotors (pair)
items.why: Your rotors are 22.4 mm, just above the 22 mm minimum. Safe for now, but due at your next service.

items.name: Brake fluid flush
items.why: There's no record of the last fluid change. Old brake fluid absorbs water, which can make the pedal feel soft.

items.name: Labour
items.why: 1.5 hours to fit the new pads and check the brakes, with a 12-month workmanship warranty.
